steps.say: The inbox contains the invoice: INV-7 from shop.sandbox for API credits, amount 2 NEAR, payable to shop.sandbox. The merchant invoice endpoint has no separate order invoice, so the inbox message is the invoice. The amount matches the agreed price of 2 NEAR, and my wallet (`agent.sandbox`) holds ~100.99 NEAR — enough to cover 2 NEAR plus gas.
